text: Wide panoramic cinematic sci-fi fantasy digital painting, a futuristic desert city in the center distance at twilight, viewed across golden-orange rippled sand dunes in the foreground with wind-blown sand. On the left dune ridge, seen from behind in silhouette, one man in a long dark burgundy cloak standing beside one fluffy brown llama. In the center background, three towering glass spires on tiered futuristic bases among smaller city buildings; the tallest central tower has a glowing cyan halo ring around its peak, the left tower has a vertical cyan neon sign reading “OASIS”, the right tower glows purple-magenta, with bright cyan searchlight beams shooting diagonally into the sky. On the right, a curved elevated monorail track with a glowing golden edge and a sleek train winds from the city toward the bottom-right corner, passing a small turquoise oasis pool. At the far right foreground, one tall green saguaro cactus outlined in pink neon, with one tiny cactus behind it. Upper left sky has a large dark planet with a bright crescent moon edge, starry deep navy sky grading to purple and orange sunset on the horizon.
